rejected_candidates.title: Cost-Efficient LLM Training with Lifetime-Aware Tensor Offloading via GPUDirect Storage
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: GPUDirect StorageとSSDへのlifetime-aware tensor offloadは技術的に強いが、対象はLLM training activation/tensor migrationであり、現在のinference systems収録範囲外。
